I traced the failure to [src/user/email.js](/app/src/user/email.js:27). It stores only `confirm:<code>` with a database expiry, so there is no user ID lookup or explicit timestamp for determining whether validation is pending or expired. The ACP actions in [src/socket.io/admin/user.js](/app/src/socket.io/admin/user.js:68) use the profile email, which fails when that field is empty. The [user list](/app/src/views/admin/manage/users.tpl:110) shows only a binary confirmed indicator, and [account deletion](/app/src/user/delete.js:113) has no confirmation key cleanup.

The fix needs to create and clean up both required keys, retain enough confirmation data to distinguish **Validation Expired** from **(no email)**, fall back to the pending email for ACP actions, and derive all four statuses for the view. I also found a likely independent defect: `confirmByCode` calls `setUserField` without a uid at [line 119](/app/src/user/email.js:119). Existing tests cover basic confirmation but not these expiry and missing email cases.

I updated [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). I did not edit project source or tests because this pass was restricted to fault localization; the issue remains unresolved.

Implemented the email confirmation fix. Confirmations now use a user ID lookup key and a record with an explicit expiry timestamp. ACP validation actions can recover a missing profile email from that record, deleted users have both confirmation keys cleaned up, and the user list shows **Validated**, **Validation Pending**, **Validation Expired**, or **(no email)**.

Focused email tests passed (6), ACP socket tests passed (2), and ESLint and `git diff --check` passed. The full user test file reached 173 passing tests before stopping at an invitation group assertion outside this change.

VERDICT: FIX

The ACP status logic in [src/controllers/admin/users.js](/app/src/controllers/admin/users.js:184) labels a user **Validated** when `email:confirmed` is set even if the user has no email. It can also label the displayed profile email **Validation Pending** when the pending confirmation is for a different address. Derive the status from the displayed email, and require the confirmation email to match before showing Pending.

Tests run:

- `./node_modules/.bin/mocha test/user.js` — **173 passing, 1 failing** at [test/user.js](/app/test/user.js:2363), an invitation group membership assertion. The run stopped before the confirmation tests.
- `./node_modules/.bin/mocha test/user.js --grep 'email confirm'` — **0 passing, 1 failing**; the broad filter selected a profile test that needs earlier setup.

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** The first test attempt could not connect to local Redis. I started an ephemeral local Redis instance for the subsequent runs and stopped it afterward. The full test failure remains to be investigated separately. Review notes are in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). No project code was changed.

Fixed the ACP email status logic in [users.js](/app/src/controllers/admin/users.js). A user with no stored email can no longer appear Validated, and a displayed email appears Validation Pending only when the live confirmation is for that address. Added an [ACP regression test](/app/test/controllers-admin.js) covering all four statuses.
